description: This Dart source file defines an API client for a Flutter frontend, encapsulating HTTP request logic, error handling, and configuration for API interactions, including authorization and response parsing.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling API errors, carrying HTTP status code, message, URI, and optional cause.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class for performing HTTP GET and POST requests to a specified API, with support for token-based authorization, default headers, and response parsing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified path with optional query parameters and headers, returning the parsed JSON or raw response.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to a specified path with an optional JSON body and headers, returning the parsed JSON or raw response.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full URI from the base URL, provided path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Merges default headers, authorization token (if available), and request-specific headers.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response, decoding JSON when appropriate, and throws an ApiException on errors.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Utility to produce a truncated preview of a string for logging purposes.
